```json
  "code": "# Get existing objects
body = doc.getObject("Body")
sketch = doc.getObject("Sketch")
pad = doc.getObject("Pad")

# Create new sketch for pocket on Pad's top face
pocket_sketch = body.newObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "PocketSketch")

# Set placement to attach to Pad's top face (outer end of pad)
# Pad extends in Z direction from sketch plane; top face is at Z=pad.Length
pocket_sketch.AttachmentSupport = [(pad, ["Face3"])]
pocket_sketch.MapMode = "FlatFace"

# Get the center of the original circle from sketch geometry
orig_circle = sketch.Geometry[3]
center_x = orig_circle.Center.x
center_y = orig_circle.Center.y

# Add a concentric circle with 4mm radius
geo_circle = Part.Circle()
geo_circle.Radius = pocket_radius_mm
geo_circle.Location = App.Vector(center_x, center_y, 0.0)
pocket_sketch.addGeometry(geo_circle, False)

# Add constraints to make circle fully defined relative to sketch origin
# PointOnOrigin constraint for center
pocket_sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Coincident", 0, -1, 0, 0))

# Create the Pocket feature
pocket = body.newObject("PartDesign::Pocket", "Pocket")
pocket.Profile = [pocket_sketch, []]
pocket.BaseFeature = pad
pocket.Type = "Dimension"
pocket.Depth = App.Units.Quantity(str(pocket_depth_mm), "mm")
pocket.Reversed = False
pocket.Midplane = False

# Compute to update shapes
doc.recompute()"
}
```
